title: Employees and pay
description:
Use inheritance to pay different kinds of employee.

```
Ada (salaried): 3,500.00
Bob (hourly, 160 h): 2,400.00
Cy (sales, 20,000.00 sold): 2,800.00
Total: 8,700.00
```
hints: `class Hourly(string name, decimal hours, decimal rate) : Employee(name)` passes the name on to the base constructor (lesson 3.03).
Ada earns 42,000 a year (3,500 a month); Bob works 160 hours at 15.00; Cy sold 20,000.
requirements: `abstract class Employee` with `Name` and `abstract decimal MonthlyPay()`; `override ToString()` uses a virtual `Describe()`.
Total the pay of a `List<Employee>` without checking types.
stretch: Add a bonus that only some employees get, through an interface `IBonus`.
